description: Core semantic elements representing the nature of entities, actions, states of being, and temporal or relational contexts

Grammatical connectives and auxiliary verbs, punctuation marks and structural elements, numerical or time indicators, common action verbs, general conceptual nouns and high-frequency proper names, and word fragments completing frequent terms

Punctuation marking statement completion, queries, or emphasis; words referring to context or additional information; numerical sequences within identifiers; expressions of inquiry, interest, or necessity; and key descriptive terms, specific entities, or intensifying modifiers
Product and service attributes, their design and functionality, meeting user requirements, and expressions of positive sentiment or appreciation
Punctuation marks, and specific word tokens that complete or form integral parts of multi-word expressions, named entities, numerical sequences, or descriptive constructions
